name: Overlays

guide.summary: Colour the dish by one amount at a time, such as sugar, oxygen or light.
guide.biology: Scientists map chemicals and light with stains, probes and sensors. Here the game shows its own numbers directly.
guide.rules: One overlay at a time, drawn over the dish with a legend from low to high. An overlay is offered only when the dish has that amount. Overlays only show what the dish records; they never change it. All numbers are fictional game units.
guide.example: Turn on the Oxygen overlay over a crowded patch of Sprinters and look for where oxygen runs low.

doesNotChange: Anything in the dish: looking never changes it.
watchFor: Where food runs low around a group, or where oxygen drops.
